source.title: Clearing the Path
source.description: The pounding in my head has subsided somewhat, but I don't think I can fight my way out of here on my own yet. I hate to ask more of you, but could you help thin the ranks and clear a path for me to make my escape?
source.objective: Kill 5 Blighted Zombies, 10 Skeletal Terrors, and 10 Rotting Cadavers to help clear a path for Squire Cuthbert to escape.
source.completion:
Thank you again, <class>. If we had someone like you with us when we were ambushed, I'm quite sure the ambush would have turned into a rout against our attackers in minutes!

I've got my second wind now and must find Sir Dalton. He is a most skilled knight, but I am sure he needs my aid. Tell me, have you seen him out there? He's hard to miss in his gleaming white plate armor.
